# Your Path to Becoming a Certified Meshery Contributor Starts Here

**Date:** 2026-02-11
**Source:** http://discuss.meshery.io//t/your-path-to-becoming-a-certified-meshery-contributor-starts-here/7652

---

<p>This study group has been formed to help you prepare for the Certified Meshery Contributor (CMC) certification while building an understanding of how to contribute across the different architectural areas of the <strong>Meshery</strong> project.</p>
<p>You won’t be doing it alone, you’ll be learning alongside others on the same journey.<br>
These will be 60-minute live sessions on <strong>Fridays</strong> where we will gradually cover each certification unit – Meshery CLI (mesheryctl), Meshery Extensibility, Meshery Models, Meshery Server and Meshery UI. They are designed to help you prepare confidently for the exam through simple learning sessions, practical exercises, and interactive discussions.</p>
<p>And yes… by the end of this study group, you’ll be ready for certification — a real, honest-to-goodness <strong>CNCF Certified Meshery Contributor</strong> certification to proudly pin to your profiles and resume. <img src="https://discuss.meshery.io/images/emoji/twitter/tada.png?v=15" title=":tada:" class="emoji" alt=":tada:" loading="lazy" width="20" height="20"></p>
<p><img src="https://discuss.meshery.io/images/emoji/twitter/date.png?v=15" title=":date:" class="emoji" alt=":date:" loading="lazy" width="20" height="20"> Sessions are held every <strong>Friday</strong><br>
<img src="https://discuss.meshery.io/images/emoji/twitter/alarm_clock.png?v=15" title=":alarm_clock:" class="emoji" alt=":alarm_clock:" loading="lazy" width="20" height="20"> 9:30AM - 10:30 AM CT | 9:00PM - 10:00 PM IST | 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM UTC</p>
<p><img src="https://discuss.meshery.io/images/emoji/twitter/backhand_index_pointing_right.png?v=15" title=":backhand_index_pointing_right:" class="emoji" alt=":backhand_index_pointing_right:" loading="lazy" width="20" height="20"> <strong>The first session kicks off on Friday, February 13th.</strong></p>
<p>Make sure to subscribe to the <a href="https://layer5.io/community/calendar#meetings">community calendar</a> to stay updated and join upcoming sessions at <a href="http://meet.meshery.io/cmc">http://meet.meshery.io/cmc</a>. You can find the meeting minutes <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O0l7eHX5dTkxdTXfebzvkoURnDexKFuw3lw2beUCSYM/edit?tab=t.0">here</a>.</p>
